title: Nineveh
summary: Nineveh was the great Assyrian city associated with empire, violence, repentance in Jonah, and later judgment in Nahum.
background: The Bible presents Nineveh as both a city that once heard warning and a symbol of arrogant imperial cruelty that came under God’s justice.
teachingHelp: When teaching Nineveh, hold together God’s mercy in warning and God’s justice against persistent violence.
